Class Index

java.lang.Object
msfx.lib.md.Index
public class Index extends Object
An index of a table.

An index belongs to the table given when it is created, and is made of a list of columns of that table, not repeated. It is assigned to the table either as its primary key, see Table.setPrimaryKey(Index), or as a secondary index, see Table.addIndex(Index). The table then sets whether it is unique, and its name if not set.

Author:
Miquel Sas

    • addColumns

      public void addColumns(String... columnNames)
      Adds columns at the end of the index, in the order given. Either all the columns are added or, if any name is invalid, none.
      Parameters:
      columnNames - The names of the columns, exactly as in the table.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If a name is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - If the table has no column with a name, or a column is already in the index or repeated in the names.

    • getColumns
